messages.text: The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Removed the match and victory tones from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts). Pair matching and victory handling remain in place.

Type checking, the production build, and all 138 unit and static tests passed. The browser suite passed 75 checks, including a complete game with no audio; one face-sheet check timed out during the suite and passed when rerun on its own.

The formatting check still flags three unrelated test files: `scripts/replay.test.ts`, `tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts`, and `tests/layout.e2e.test.ts`.
